name: CosmoMask #16404
description:
**CosmoMask #16404**

 By owning a [CosmoMask NFT](https://thecosmomasks.com/?utm_source=OpenSea&utm_medium=mask_description), you accumulate a [CosmoMasks Power (CMP)](https://info.uniswap.org/token/0xB9FDc13F7f747bAEdCc356e9Da13Ab883fFa719B) every day. That allows you to choose a name for your NFT on the Ethereum Blockchain and earn [COSMO](https://info.uniswap.org/token/0x27cd7375478F189bdcF55616b088BE03d9c4339c) on the [CosmoSwap.space](https://cosmoswap.space/farms?utm_source=OpenSea&utm_medium=mask_description).

 Be the first owner of a CosmoMask and get a bonus of 10,000 [COSMO](https://info.uniswap.org/token/0x27cd7375478F189bdcF55616b088BE03d9c4339c) and 1,830 [CMP](https://info.uniswap.org/token/0xB9FDc13F7f747bAEdCc356e9Da13Ab883fFa719B) for each mask!

**Sonora**

Sonoria planet. These are thousands of small planets that are very close to each other. Each planet is inhabited by one Sonor only. All planets are not alike, like snowflakes in our world, they have their differences, but brighter. Each planet is a fantasy of its inhabitant. It creates it as it wants, fills it with plants, forms the space, decides whether there will be water or not and in which direction it should flow, even upwards; they control everything that surrounds them, changing following their mood. All this they can do thanks to a small golden spherule, thanks to it they also communicate with each other. Sonorans are very fond of music and arrange incredible concerts in their universe, if we are lucky enough to get there one day, we will see a beautiful dance of a thousand planets.
